definition.child: a separate process imports the exported table under verifier:v1, expresses the pair template for the 20 describe sentences, corrects the CUP description to GREEN, expresses again, and exports
definition.before: the child's 20 before texts must equal '{object}在{place}'
definition.after: the child's 20 after texts must substitute GREEN for CUP and keep every place
definition.handback: the parent imports the child export; digest, audit entry and the 20 after texts must match
definition.corrupt: a second child receives truncated bytes and must reject them with rejected_import_invalid_state and write no output
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.child_import: child imported digest equals the parent digest
criteria.after: 20/20 after pairs and texts exact; CUP sentences become GREEN; places unchanged
criteria.handback: parent digest equals child export digest; 20/20 after texts; one audit entry with verifier:v1
criteria.corrupt: child result error starts with rejected_import_invalid_state and no output exists
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R28 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
